159/2024.title: Planning food scraps collection
159/2024.description: Preparations for a Council-wide food collection service and regional waste programs.
159/2024.decisionSummary: Council gives research and implementation of food collection highest priority, requests updates on regional waste studies and programs, and asks for the incoming Council to be briefed on food-waste processing options.

60/2025.title: Food collection: next steps
60/2025.description: Steps towards introducing a food organics collection service.
60/2025.decisionSummary: Council notes the waste services report and endorses its next steps towards introducing a food organics service.

101/2025.title: Market Square maintenance responsibilities
101/2025.description: Complaints about lifts, escalators, toilets and other shared areas at Market Square.
101/2025.decisionSummary: Council requests a workshop on Market Square ownership, management and maintenance arrangements, enforcement limits, and options to improve service standards. The motion records complaints about breakdowns, cleanliness, amenity and safety.

160/2024.title: Lane Cove North traffic calming
160/2024.description: Crossings, speed humps, narrower-looking roads and other traffic-calming works in Lane Cove North.
160/2024.decisionSummary: Council approves construction of the Lane Cove North speed reduction scheme, subject to detailed design. Treatments include crossings, speed humps, footpath treatments, Karilla Avenue parking lanes and narrowing, and associated signs and road markings.

201/2023.title: Drainage reserve sale deferred
201/2023.description: The proposed sale of drainage reserve land near Morrice Street and Tambourine Bay Road.
201/2023.decisionSummary: Council defers the proposed sale to November and requests a report addressing matters raised at the October meeting.

218/2023.title: Drainage reserve working group
218/2023.description: Further consideration of the Morrice Street and Tambourine Bay Road drainage reserve sale.
218/2023.decisionSummary: Council defers the sale proposal and establishes a working group of staff, ward councillors and affected residents. A further report is requested once the group determines a way forward.

96/2024.title: Staff interaction policy deferred
96/2024.description: Rules for communication and interaction between councillors and Council staff.
96/2024.decisionSummary: Council defers the draft policy to June, requests a workshop and legal advice on proposed changes, and asks for reporting measures and a review after implementation.

124/2024.title: Staff interaction policy exhibition
124/2024.description: Public consultation and a trial of the amended Councillor and Staff Interaction Policy.
124/2024.decisionSummary: Council includes the proposed amendments in the draft policy, places it on public exhibition for six weeks and trials it during consultation.

224+225/2024.title: Reviewing local planning rules
224+225/2024.description: A review of Lane Cove planning rules covering sustainability, biodiversity, tree canopy and affordable housing.
224+225/2024.decisionSummary: Council starts an 18-month Local Environmental Plan review, requests a work program, and asks staff to examine affordable-housing policy options. It also prioritises the proposed conservation zoning for 14 Gay Street and seeks clearer State affordable-housing rules.

39/2025.title: Planning review work program
39/2025.description: The work program for reviewing Lane Cove planning rules for sustainability and affordable housing.
39/2025.decisionSummary: Council endorses the review program, notifies the NSW planning department of its intention to review the Local Environmental Plan, and starts supporting affordable-housing policies.

230/2024.title: Reviewing St Leonards South contributions
230/2024.description: A review of developer contributions, infrastructure works and park funding in St Leonards South.
230/2024.decisionSummary: Council requests the scheduled three-year contributions-plan review, including planning assumptions, land acquisition and works costs and timing. It also investigates earlier funding for the new local park and requires proposed amendments to return to Council.

129/2025.title: Contributions plan exhibition
129/2025.description: Proposed works and developer contribution rates for St Leonards South.
129/2025.decisionSummary: Council places the draft works schedule and contribution rates on exhibition for 28 days. Staff must report the consultation results to Council before submission to IPART.

156/2025.title: 170 Pacific Highway agreement deferred
156/2025.description: A proposed planning agreement for development at 170 Pacific Highway, Greenwich.
156/2025.decisionSummary: Council delays the agreement decision to allow the new General Manager and councillors to review its background and public benefits. It requests an August workshop update and a review of Council planning-agreement practices.

69/2025.title: 177–183 Greenwich Road planning proposal
69/2025.description: Proposed changes to height and floor-space controls at 177–183 Greenwich Road.
69/2025.decisionSummary: Council supports Planning Proposal 41 with lower height and floor-space controls and sends it for Gateway determination. It authorises final amendments and requires the proposed planning agreement to return before the planning changes are gazetted.

36/2023.short: St Leonards South: Areas 22 and 23 agreement
36/2023.title: St Leonards South: Areas 22 and 23 agreement
36/2023.description: A planning agreement for development in Areas 22 and 23 of St Leonards South.
36/2023.decisionSummary: Council agrees to enter a planning agreement with JQZ Twelve for Areas 22 and 23. It authorises the General Manager to review trustee provisions, finalise the wording and sign the agreement.

100/2025.title: Dunois Reserve watercraft and dumping
100/2025.description: Abandoned boats, illegal dumping and proposed watercraft storage near Dunois Reserve and Woodford Bay.
100/2025.decisionSummary: Council endorses the abandoned-watercraft program, focuses its next stage on Woodford Bay, requests action on dumping and illegal moorings, and starts consultation on grant-funded storage racks. Monthly program updates are requested.

208/2025.title: Dunois Reserve boat rack designs
208/2025.description: Design and consultation for watercraft storage racks at Dunois Reserve.
208/2025.decisionSummary: Council requests draft boat-rack designs for further consultation, amendments following feedback, and a final proposal for adoption.

140/2025.title: Events policy exhibition
140/2025.description: Public consultation on revised rules for events in Lane Cove.
140/2025.decisionSummary: Council endorses the revised Events Management Policy for exhibition and requests a report on the consultation results.

164/2025.title: Meeting code: July draft
164/2025.description: A draft Code of Meeting Practice for public consultation.
164/2025.decisionSummary: Council places the draft 2025 meeting code on exhibition for two weeks. It notes that a revised State model code is expected and requests a report on submissions and proposed amendments for August.

202/2025.title: Meeting code: revised model
202/2025.description: Consultation on the revised meeting code and proposed public forum arrangements.
202/2025.decisionSummary: Council exhibits the draft meeting code for six weeks, endorses public forums immediately before ordinary meetings from 6.30pm to 7.30pm, and requests a November report on submissions. It also asks the Office of Local Government for implementation training.

175/2025.title: Canberra Avenue works: first update
175/2025.description: An update on proposed changes to Canberra Avenue works under the Silver Pond planning agreement.
175/2025.decisionSummary: Council receives and notes the progress report on varying the Canberra Avenue works and planning agreement.

250/2025.title: Aquatic Centre electrification funding
250/2025.description: Funding to replace some Aquatic Centre gas boilers and improve the efficiency of others.
250/2025.decisionSummary: Council notes a $1,114,500 federal grant, $749,000 in Council funding and $400,000 from BlueFit. It applies the funding to boiler replacement and efficiency works and acknowledges the staff grant application.

128/2025.short: Galuwa food and events tenders declined
128/2025.title: Galuwa food and events tenders declined
128/2025.description: Options for running food, beverage and events services at the recreation centre.
128/2025.decisionSummary: Council declines all tender submissions and postpones the proposed contract. It requests a councillor workshop and a report on operating options, including a preferred option and operator if identified.

256/2024.title: Recreation centre operating tenders
256/2024.description: Council oversight of proposed recreation centre operating tenders, including bistro and events services.
256/2024.decisionSummary: Council requests a written tender overview and a February briefing covering operating models, community service goals and bistro and events arrangements. It requires experienced external expertise on the tender review panels.

70/2023.title: Baths restoration investigation
70/2023.description: Options for restoring the closed Jean Mitchell Lucretia Baths and involving the community.
70/2023.decisionSummary: Council supports restoring the Baths, requests plans, approval requirements and funding advice, and seeks community interest in volunteering and sponsorship. Safety restrictions remain while the Baths are closed. The restoration funding model is to be reviewed at the 2024 planning weekend.

36/2024.title: Baths restoration: further information
36/2024.description: Further design, lease, safety and cost information for the Baths restoration proposal.
36/2024.decisionSummary: Council requests publication of design information, continued site security and a June report on lease obligations and costs. It defers reconsideration of funding until the recreation centre is completed and asks for a walk-out structure to be considered as an option.

126/2024.short: Baths funding sent to planning weekend
126/2024.title: Baths funding sent to planning weekend
126/2024.description: Budget timing for the proposed Jean Mitchell Lucretia Baths restoration.
126/2024.decisionSummary: Council notes the report and refers restoration funding and timing to the 2025 Corporate Planning Weekend for consideration in the 2025/26 budget.

18/2022.title: Lane Cove North neighbourhood shops
18/2022.description: An investigation into possible neighbourhood shops in the Lane Cove North and Mowbray precinct.
18/2022.decisionSummary: Council writes to owners of undeveloped high-density residential land about interest in neighbourhood shops and requests a further report if owners wish to proceed.

200/2024.title: Lane Cove North shop sites
200/2024.description: Possible commercial space and neighbourhood-shop sites in Lane Cove North.
200/2024.decisionSummary: Council seeks discussions with Willoughby Council, NSW Ministers and Homes NSW about commercial space in the Mindarie Street proposal. It also includes a study of possible neighbourhood-shop sites in the next Local Environmental Plan review.

174/2025.title: Joining the asylum-seeker taskforce
174/2025.description: Council participation in a local government taskforce supporting people seeking asylum.
174/2025.decisionSummary: Council joins the taskforce as a Supporter Council, investigates advocacy opportunities and requests a report on becoming a General Member Council in 2026/27.

50/2023.title: Badangi heritage listing proposal
50/2023.description: Proposed State heritage protection for Manns Point, Greendale Park and Holloway Reserve as Badangi.
50/2023.decisionSummary: Council supports the proposed listing, seeks feedback from community groups and advisory bodies, and authorises finalisation of works exemptions. If listed, the protection is to be noted in the relevant land management plans.

103/2023.title: Badangi listing consultation results
103/2023.description: Consultation and works exemptions for the Badangi State heritage listing.
103/2023.decisionSummary: Council adopts the amended works-exemptions list for Heritage NSW and agrees to consider Holloway Reserve needs at its next planning weekend.

75/2023.title: Council development conflicts policy: draft
75/2023.description: Rules for managing conflicts of interest when Council has a role in a development.
75/2023.decisionSummary: Council adopts the draft as an interim policy, exhibits it for at least 28 days with State explanatory material, and requests a report before final adoption.

127/2023.title: Council development conflicts policy adopted
127/2023.description: The final policy for conflicts of interest in Council-related development.
127/2023.decisionSummary: Council adopts the Managing Conflicts of Interests for Council-related Developments Policy and publishes it on its website.

72/2025.title: Data centre planning safeguards
72/2025.description: Requests for stronger planning, environmental and infrastructure requirements for data centres.
72/2025.decisionSummary: Council writes to Ministers seeking local development assessment, community consultation, environmental safeguards and clearer controls for data centres and cabling works. It also raises resource demand with NSROC.

67+68/2024.title: Children and Families Strategy commissioned
67+68/2024.description: A new Children and Families Strategy and tender preparation for the St Leonards South early childhood centre.
67+68/2024.decisionSummary: Council unanimously agrees to start a Children and Families Strategy under resolution 67. A separate vote under resolution 68 approves preparing the early childhood centre operating tender and reporting its outcome. The original proposal for a Council-operated model was lost.

119/2023.title: Canberra Avenue closure consultation
119/2023.description: Consultation on partly closing Canberra Avenue and adding the land to Newlands Park.
119/2023.decisionSummary: Council approves consultation and public notification on the proposed partial closure, requests a further report before deciding the closure, and agrees to a peak-hour site inspection with residents. The foreshadowed motion was carried unanimously.

199/2023.title: Canberra Avenue closure supported
199/2023.description: Council consideration of closing part of Canberra Avenue and extending Newlands Park.
199/2023.decisionSummary: Council confirms its intention to close the road section, retains vehicle access until at least November 2025 near development completion, refers traffic arrangements for comment and requests a Newlands Park masterplan. Minutes record this as resolution 200; the tracker labels it 199.
